origin.description: Coerce the table for later lookups and attach the hash.
origin.usage: fmatch.hash(x, table, nomatch = NA_integer_, incomparables = NULL)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Used only to choose the type of the table.

arguments.name: nomatch
arguments.text: Ignored unless the call falls back to match().

arguments.name: incomparables
arguments.text: A value other than NULL or a single FALSE falls back to match().

origin.details: No lookup is done when the type is integer, real, or character. The returned table carries the hash. An unsupported type warns and returns the match() positions instead.
origin.value: The table, possibly coerced, or the match positions when the type is unsupported.
origin.example:
h <- fmatch.hash("a", c(1L, 2L, 1L))
cat(paste(h, collapse = " "), "\n")
print(attr(h, ".match.hash"))
